subject: QTown Tech Fair — booth commitment, vendor POs, & payment routing
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QTown Tech Fair — booth commitment, vendor POs, & payment routing

Hi team,

Quick one — QTown asked us to confirm our booth and AV by next Wednesday. Estimated committed spend: $18,500 (Booth shell + graphics $8,700, AV package $6,200, venue deposit $3,600). I attached the BluePeak AV quote and the draft deposit invoice from Ember Hall.

Asks:
- Can finance issue a PO for the AV vendor and the venue deposit (we'd prefer POs rather than PCard for these two)?
- Cost center to charge: Marketing Q2 event budget (I propose cost center 30012 / GL 6002 - Events).
- If PO is preferred, can we get an initial PO for the deposit ($3,600) and a second PO for AV ($6,200)? Total committed now would be $9,800.

Marissa / Logan — I need confirmation of the spend cap and routing to proceed. If this needs manager sign-off for >$15k, please advise so I can pause additional commitments.

Attachments: BoothQuote_BluePeak.pdf, EmberHall_Deposit_Invoice.xlsx

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QTown Tech Fair — booth commitment, vendor POs, & payment routing

Thanks Priyom — this looks straightforward. A couple of quick notes: 

- Approve splitting into two POs: Venue deposit (Ember Hall) and AV (BluePeak). Travel/honoraria we’ll keep to PCard reimbursement unless amounts exceed the card limits.
- Please capture a short Mutual Action Plan (one page) with deliverables and dates — we need that for contract signoff. I drafted a template and dropped it in the event folder.
- Cost center 30012 works for the marketing event bucket; confirm project code if you'd like a separate tracking line.

If Logan or Dylan need to route differently, ping here. Otherwise Priyom, go ahead and ask Finance to create PO(s) and attach vendor W9s when available.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Field Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-13T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QTown Tech Fair — booth commitment, vendor POs, & payment routing

Quick add — approvals note: anything over $15k needs director sign-off per spend policy. Grace, tagging you for the raise to the full estimated amount ($18.5k).

Operationally, prefer: 
- PR-PO for Ember Hall deposit (so they have formal confirmation).
- AV vendor can be on separate PO and paid via AP to keep clear vendor lines.
- If BluePeak needs a deposit, we can do a partial PO release.

Priyom, if you can upload the vendor quotes and the MAP (mutual action plan) to the Drive link Logan referenced, we'll put the PO through as soon as finance confirms.

Thanks,
Logan
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QTown Tech Fair — booth commitment, vendor POs, & payment routing

Approved to proceed up to $20,000 contingent on two items: 1) signed venue contract or DocuSign envelope in progress, and 2) a one-page mutual action plan (deliverables + dates) added to the event folder.

Priyom — please confirm when the MAP is uploaded and tag me. Also confirm whether BluePeak provided an estimate only or if they require a non-refundable deposit; if non-refundable, mark it explicitly in the PO request.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-16T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QTown Tech Fair — booth commitment, vendor POs, & payment routing

All — I created an initial PO for the deposit and AV. Please see details below: 

PO Number: PR-2027-1128
Lines:
 - Ember Hall deposit (line 1): $3,600 — Vendor: Ember Hall Events (events@emberhall.com)
 - BluePeak AV (line 2): $6,200 — Vendor: BluePeak AV (sales@bluepeakav.com)

GL suggestion: 6002 - Events. Cost center: 30012. Project code (optional): MARKETING-Q2-QTOWN

Next items we need from PRIYOM: vendor W9(s) for both vendors, a signed contract or DocuSign link for the venue, and confirmation if BluePeak requires a deposit. I attached the PO stub for your records.

Note on payment timing: Ember Hall will invoice after we submit the PO; AP will process on receipt of invoice. For BluePeak, if they require prepay we’ll route a partial release once we have the W9 and signed MAP.

Attachment: PO_PR-2027-1128.pdf

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Finance Business Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-03-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QTown Tech Fair — booth commitment, vendor POs, & payment routing

Thanks everyone — quick update and confirmations: 

- Mutual Action Plan uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/qtown-2027/MutualActionPlan_QTown (file: MutualActionPlan_QTown.docx).
- Ember Hall has returned a signed venue agreement via DocuSign (link included in Drive). They require the $3,600 deposit, refundable per contract terms below.
- BluePeak confirmed they require a 50% deposit to secure AV gear. I've asked them for a W9 and a deposit invoice.

I've attached the vendor quote and Ember Hall draft invoice and the PO stub Dylan created. Please proceed with PO issuance and partial release as discussed.

Attachments: BoothQuote_BluePeak.pdf; EmberHall_Deposit_Invoice.xlsx; PO_PR-2027-1128.pdf

If finance needs any additional info, ping me and I’ll get it today.

—Priyom
